## Regression Example


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflreadr)
fantasy2026 <- load_player_stats(2026, summary_level = "reg") |>
  dplyr::filter(position %in% c("RB","WR","TE")) |>
  select(player_display_name,position,games,
         carries,rushing_yards,rushing_tds,
         receptions,targets,receiving_yards,receiving_tds,
         fantasy_points_ppr)|>
  as.data.frame() 
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1023)
df=fantasy2026
n=nrow(df)
s=sample(n,0.7*n)
train=df[s,]
test=df[-s,]
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(randomForest)
fantasy_rf=randomForest(fantasy_points_ppr~.,
                        data=train[,-1])
fantasy_rf
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

Call:
 randomForest(formula = fantasy_points_ppr ~ ., data = train[,      -1]) 
               Type of random forest: regression
                     Number of trees: 500
No. of variables tried at each split: 3

          Mean of squared residuals: 50.0336
                    % Var explained: 97.55
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
yhat=predict(fantasy_rf,test)
sqrt(mean((test$fantasy_points_ppr-yhat)^2)) # RMSE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 6.827599
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
varImpPlot(fantasy_rf)
```

## Classification Example


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/mushroom.csv"
mushroom=read.csv(df_url)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1023)
df=mushroom
n=nrow(df)
s=sample(n,0.7*n)
train=df[s,]
test=df[-s,]
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mush_rf=randomForest(factor(class)~.,data=train)
mush_rf
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

Call:
 randomForest(formula = factor(class) ~ ., data = train) 
               Type of random forest: classification
                     Number of trees: 500
No. of variables tried at each split: 4

        OOB estimate of  error rate: 0%
Confusion matrix:
     e    p class.error
e 2961    0           0
p    0 2725           0
```


:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
yhat=predict(mush_rf,newdata=test,type="class")
table(yhat,test$class)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

